entries.what: no help or reference command in the CLI; an unknown command prints only the list of verbs, not their arguments (tools/mcp/language.md exists but the CLI does not serve it)
no ISO 273 clearance-hole table (M5 -> 5.5 typed by the agent)
no ISO 273 table; no NEMA ICS 16 motor-flange record
no DIN 472 / ISO 464 retaining-ring groove data and no ring-groove feature (groove drawn into the revolve profile by hand)
ISO 286 tolerance classes can only be applied inside pmi fits with a mating cylinder; a lone bore or shaft cannot be given H7 or k5 (the agent typed the zone as a parameter)
no turning/lathe process check (tool reach, grooving insert, boring bar)
no DIN 471 groove data, no DIN 6885 key/keyway data, no keyway feature (box difference used)
no counterbore feature, no DIN 974 counterbore data, no ISO 4762 cap screw part, holes only on planar faces
no involute gear feature or ISO 53/21771 profile: teeth are agent-generated polylines (docs/receipts/g3/gear.py); conjugate action and backlash are not certified
fillet only on a box (all 12 edges), cylinder rims, one box vertical edge or a circular edge in a planar face; no fillet along a prism edge loop; no shell on a prism
no print-process checks (overhang, bridging, minimum feature) and no heat-set insert data
no EN 1092-1 / ASME B16.5 flange data and no ISO 3601 O-ring/gland data or squeeze check
no certified clearance over a motion range: assembly orientations are fixed to quarter turns, and asm mesh only rotates z-extruded gear traces; hinge swing sampled at four angles
no modelled-thread feature: a helical thread is a skin of helix sections from tools/g5/threads.py
no countersink feature or ISO 15065 data: a 45-degree chamfer on the hole edge stands in (only 90-degree countersinks expressible)
no bearing catalog part (608 modelled as a plain ring) and no ISO 492 bearing ring tolerances; pmi fits admits holes D-H and JS only, so the bearing-bore-on-k5 fit cannot be evaluated
circular pattern only N = 4 by translation; no rotational pattern of a feature or body

no query reports a hole diameter or position: dist from a point on a hole axis returns lo = 0 (face-box bound). Workaround: a gauge cylinder coaxial with the hole and `clearance` (exact coaxial radial bound), used in B2 and B3
